description: Photovoltaic generation data, for 3 years, regarding the 2022-3 Competition on solar generation forecasting is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Luis Gomes, Zita Vale (Polytechnic of Porto). These data were released under the 2022-3 Competition on solar generation forecasting. Please check our competitions: www.gecad.isep.ipp.pt/smartgridcompetitions The data set comprises the power generated by photovoltaic panels and data collected from a near weather station. The data was collected in 5 minutes periods. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
